success.title: Success
success.description: Whether the instance repo itself was successfully replaced.

message.description: Detail message from the restore operation.

projects_restored.title: Projects Restored
projects_restored.description: Guids of projects successfully re-cloned from their configured remote.

projects_failed.title: Projects Failed
projects_failed.description: Projects whose remote was configured but couldn't be cloned, with the guid and error for each.

templates_restored.title: Templates Restored
templates_restored.description: Names of template groups successfully re-cloned from their configured remote.

templates_failed.title: Templates Failed
templates_failed.description: Template groups whose remote was configured but couldn't be cloned, with the name and error for each.

catalogs_restored.title: Catalogs Restored
catalogs_restored.description: Local names of catalogs successfully re-cloned from their repository.

catalogs_failed.title: Catalogs Failed
catalogs_failed.description: Catalogs that couldn't be re-cloned, with the local name and error for each.

400.description: Missing/invalid SSH URL, no SSH key available, or the remote is empty/unreachable
